newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia chooses three bidders for shipping firm.
newsitem.headline: Estonia chooses three bidders for shipping firm.

text.p: Estonia's privatisation agency on Wednesday shortlisted three bidders for a 70 percent stake in the state-owned shipping company.

The bidding groups for Estonian Shipping Company were Arbonale, which includes Jinhui Shipping and Nomura, local group Baltic Cresco and a third consortium, Esco, in which Swedish Carnegie AB is participating.

"Our chances are very good. We have an excellent team of international and local and strategic partners," said Toomas Reisenbuk, executive director of Hansa Investments, one of the groups in the Arbonale consortium.
Baltic Cresco is an investment banking firm which is two years old and has four private partners. It also has two backers, one from Estonia and one from the U.S.
"Cresco has something to offer and we are bidding to win," a representative of the firm said.
The Estonian Shipping Company has 42 vessels which have an average age of 14 years. The company's 1996 net turnover was 1.2 billion kroons and it employs 1,689 people.
